ln:4441465824.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4462771317.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate, BCO CoE.

Principal responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end credit application process: Prepare credit applications supported by rigorous analysis of financial statements, projections/modelling, industry and competitor research, and relevant market intelligence.
  • Partner with Relationship Managers: Understand transaction structures, lending purposes and repayment sources, and support the structuring of appropriate short- and long-term credit solutions.
  • Assess and mitigate risk: Identify key risks, ensure proposals align with internal credit policies and guidelines as well as applicable regulatory requirements, and recommend appropriate risk mitigants.
  • Manage and monitor a portfolio: Track compliance with financial and non-financial covenants and terms, monitor credit quality trends, and support proactive credit management actions.
  • Collaborate across HSBC: Build effective working relationships with Wholesale Credit Risks, product teams and enabling functions (e.g., operations, legal, credit services) to support execution and ongoing facility management.
  • Drive process excellence: Deliver work to agreed timelines and quality standards; suggest improvements to workflow, efficiency and credit quality.
  • Contribute to team capability (depending on experience): Support quality checks, mentoring and training of new joiners.

Requirements

  • Education: Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related discipline (exceptional Bachelor’s candidates may be considered).
  • Experience: Typically 1–6 years’ experience in credit analysis, wholesale lending or relevant corporate finance is preferred. Outstanding fresh graduates with strong academic backgrounds and a clear interest in developing in credit analytics are also welcome.
  • Core credit skills: Strong grounding in accounting, financial analysis, cash flow forecasting, credit assessment and risk identification/mitigation. Ability to process large volumes of information and distil key issues.
  • Communication: Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills; excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to produce high-quality credit papers in English.
  • Organisation: Strong prioritisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables with attention to detail.
  • Tools: Strong proficiency in Excel and Word.
  • Knowledge add-ons (preferred): Awareness of sector drivers and market trends; basic knowledge of commercial banking products is an advantage.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4454021059.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Tech SME.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Roadmaps:

  • Define target and transitional architectures for Private Banking CRM and related ecosystems (Java services, Power Platform, data, integration, security).
  • Produce and maintain architectural roadmaps, capability maps, and evolution plans aligned to business outcomes and regulatory mandates.
  • Conduct option analyses (cost, risk, scalability, extensibility) and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Solution Design & Governance

  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture for new initiatives: context, container/service decomposition (C4), integration contracts, data flows, non-functional requirements.
  • Establish and enforce architecture standards (API versioning, event & data modeling, security patterns, resilience, observability).
  • Run design reviews and govern adherence to reference architectures, technical policies, and regulatory controls (data residency, audit, entitlements).

Integration & API Architecture

  • Define integration patterns (REST, event-driven, messaging, microservices boundaries) and ensure consistent application across squads.
  • Oversee API portfolio lifecycle: classification, reuse, deprecation, performance, and security posture; drive optimization (latency, throughput, error budgets).
  • Guide interoperability between Java services, Power Platform components (custom connectors, Dataverse schemas), and legacy/external systems.

Power Platform Architectural Oversight

  • Architect governance for environments, solution segmentation, Dataverse data models, connector design, and ALM alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Ensure secure, scalable low-code integrations that complement engineered services without duplicative logic or data silos.

Non-Functional Engineering & Risk Mitigation

  • Define and validate non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, resilience, security, observability).
  • Champion threat modeling, secure design, data classification handling, and compliance traceability.
  • Drive architectural risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation where residual risk exceeds thresholds.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Advise engineering leads on design trade-offs, refactoring strategies, and modernization sequencing.
  • Mentor architects and senior engineers in modeling techniques, integration patterns, and quality by design practices.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment (product, data, security, infrastructure, compliance) to remove structural delivery impediments.

Standards, Patterns & Reuse

  • Curate reusable patterns (authN/authZ flows, caching, error handling, telemetry, connector templates) reducing build duplication and improving consistency.
  • Promote architecture decision records (ADRs) and structured documentation to enable transparency and onboarding efficiency.

Quality & Support Readiness

  • Validate solution designs for operational readiness (runbooks alignment, tracing, capacity baselines, failover strategy).
  • Support major incident post-mortems with architectural remediation inputs and systemic improvement recommendations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years progressive experience in solution / software architecture within regulated financial services; prior hands-on engineering background (Java/API).
  • Strong expertise in API and integration architecture (REST, event-driven, messaging, microservices patterns, contract design).
  • Practical Power Platform architectural governance (Dataverse modeling, custom connectors, environment & ALM strategy).
  • Proficiency in cloud architecture (Azure preferred; AWS beneficial), security patterns (identity, encryption, secrets management), and container/microservices concepts (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Skilled in modeling (UML, C4, sequence/data flow diagrams), architectural documentation, and decision recording.
  • Solid understanding of non-functional engineering (performance, resilience, reliability, observability) and regulatory/compliance requirements (audit, data residency).
  • Experience establishing and governing architecture standards and conducting design reviews across multiple squads.
  • Strong stakeholder management and concise communication skills; ability to translate complex technical trade-offs into business impact.
  • Mentoring capability for architects/engineers; promotes reusable patterns and reduced technical debt.
  • Private Banking / CRM domain knowledge (client lifecycle, suitability, data confidentiality).
  • Certifications desirable: TOGAF / cloud (Azure) / security / Power Platform / Java.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - Data and Analytics

Principal responsibilities

  • Explore, cleanse and transform large volumes of customer, product, channel and interaction data across platforms including GCP and Hadoop.
  • Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
  • Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.
  • Build and iterate prototypes using Python/SQL and relevant tooling; create decision-ready dashboards and monitoring views in Looker.
  • Partner with CRM, product and Business stakeholders to define use cases, success metrics and test-and-learn approaches (e.g., A/B testing, champion–challenger).
  • Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
  • Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
  • Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.

Requirements

6+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.

  • Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
  • Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
  • Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Mandarin and English.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Requirements
6+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
- Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
- Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
- Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
- Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
- Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
- Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
- Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our

customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Supporting tasks to establish new business relationships and strengthening existing ones, whilst ensuring fair outcomes for all types of customers

Providing support to the communication new products, propositions and relevant market information to customers

Supporting distribution channel business development strategiesSupporting plans and strategies to generate new business as well as increase revenue for existing ones

Collaborating with internal stakeholders, which may include relationship mangers and product specialists, to maximise cross-selling opportunities for the bank

Participating in events, initiatives and activities to develop business opportunities

Protect the bank's reputation and ensuring an acceptable risk profile, whilst deepening your understanding of the client through credit and customer due diligence reviews

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Proven ability in mobile sales / channel developing and maintaining

Current product/market knowledge

Excellent Customer Service SkillsManagerial Experience

At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function

Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills

Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills

Result driven and able to work under pressure

Good spoken and written English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited
